result.reason: The added clause reaches the preferred playbook limits for CGL, E&O, cyber/privacy, and workers’ compensation, and requires certificates upon request. The stated facts indicate that TrueLink processes customer data, so the USD 5 million cyber requirement is applicable. It preserves the unrelated force majeure provision. However, requiring every coverage to continue for one year after the Agreement ends, and adding an express at-own-expense requirement, goes beyond the supplied playbook and is not strictly minimal. Applying the post-termination period indiscriminately to CGL and workers’ compensation is also less precise than limiting any tail requirement to applicable claims-made coverage.
